verdict.rationale: Fathom documents a programmatic create-webhook API endpoint that delivers new meeting content (transcript, summary, action items, CRM matches) to a URL of your choice. Each request carries signed headers, and the SDKs include a verify_webhook helper, so an AI-native user can subscribe to meeting events and verify them. Missing for 10: event coverage appears limited to new meeting content, retry and delivery semantics and webhook management (list/delete) are unevidenced, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
